turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No. I asked you two questions.
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Favorite. Then show me what you gave him a zero on.
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.
Aren't perfect. Turnitin's own guide says its indicator "should not be used as the sole basis for adverse actions against a student." What else is there?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58. I'm writing that down. Was Owen asked about any of it before the zero went in?
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
Don't. Was he asked, yes or no?
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
I'm not grading you. You've dodged that twice, so I'm taking it as a no. The zero comes off.
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.
So a seventeen-year-old got a quotation wrong. Show me the page it's on.
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.
Completely different. That's an adjective, and students change their minds. You've described three things and put none of them in front of me, Hale.
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? Owen. Put the documents in front of me.
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.
A rewrite for what, and on what evidence? The part about his record, I'll want that in an email tonight. Ten minutes.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
You're asking the wrong side of the table. You say nothing to Owen until I've seen what you have.
